name: Nozomu School Daze
source:
Your choices matter in Nozomu School Daze, a 90s shonen anime-meets-rom-com visual novel! As a college girl, Sari wants to attend school in peace. Too bad the martial artists in her life have other ideas! These 3 idiots get into a knock-down brawl – which YOU control! New genre: BATTLE ROMANCE

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4808290/Nozomu_School_Daze/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在《Nozomu School Daze》这部90年代少年动漫与ROM-COM视觉小说中，你的选择很重要！作为一名女大学生，莎莉想要平静地上学。可惜她身边的武者却另有想法！这3个白痴陷入了一场激烈的斗殴——一切由你掌控！新类型：战斗浪漫

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4808290/Nozomu_School_Daze/]Steam[/url]]
